messages.subject: Measurement invariance issue
parts:
Dear lavaan members, 

I am really hoping someone might be of help!

I am conducting a multi group SEM which includes a moderator (a path) and a mediator variable. I would like to compare this model then across two sets of groups. The results I have obtained look really good (CFI= .948, TLI= .919, RMSEA= .028, SRMR= .072). 

However, I feel like it is important to test for measurement invariance. For this I constrained factor loadings and intercept to equality. But what I think I found was that the grouping variable  did not met the threshold for metric (ΔCFI = 175.5; ΔSRMR = .005; ΔRMSEA = .008) or structural invariance (ΔCFI = 5421.4.; ΔSRMR = .005; ΔRMSEA = .008). 

So I mainly have two questions:
1) should this model be scraped and how bad is this :( ? 
2) given that chi-square is sensitive to sample size (sample size ~ 15,000 participants) and that all other specifications were met would it be reasonable to assume that invariance was in fact held across groups?

Many thanks, 
Emma
